blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Clinical trial protocols serve as the source of truth for study design, but are mostly written and used as unstructured PDF documents. Digitizing protocols turns static content into structured, machine-readable data that clinical software can analyze, validate, and execute. Coding agents, which select tools, execute code, and revise their approach as they work, are increasingly applied to such long-document tasks, yet it remains unclear how reliably they turn complete documents into accurate structured outputs. We study this question using protocol digitization as a testbed. We introduce TrialPD-Bench, an expert-annotated benchmark of 150 publicly available protocol PDFs spanning four task categories. Beyond final-answer performance, our evaluation measures evidence recall from agent traces, agent behavior, and cost. Across nine proprietary and open-weight models in five coding-agent harnesses, even the strongest agents do not fully solve protocol digitization. Our analysis further shows that agents usually locate the required evidence but fail in the last mile of transcribing and structuring it. We further develop TrialScribe, a domain-specific harness that equips coding agents with task skills and a verification loop. TrialScribe improves a locally served open-weight model by 6.2-59.4 points across eight metrics, enabling it to match or surpass proprietary models such as GPT-5.6-Sol.
blocks.zh: 临床试验协议作为研究设计的真理来源,但大多是被写作并用作无结构的PDF文件. 数字化协议将静态内容转化为结构化的可机器读取的数据,临床软件可以分析,验证和执行. 选择工具、执行代码和在工作过程中修改方法的编码代理越来越多地应用于这种长文件任务,但目前仍不清楚它们如何可靠地将完整的文件转化为准确的结构化产出。 我们用协议数字化来研究这个问题。 我们引入了TrialPD-Bench,这是一个由150个公开协议PDF组成的专家说明的基准,涵盖四个任务类别。 除了最后的回答,我们的评估 衡量证据 从代理追踪,代理行为和成本。 在5个编码代理机的9个专有和开放量级模型中,即使是最强的代理机也无法完全解决协议数字化问题. 我们的分析进一步表明,特工通常会找到所需的证据,但在转录和结构的最后一英里中失败了。 我们进一步发展了TrimeScribe,这是一种针对特定域的用具,它使编码人员具备任务技能和核查循环。 TrialScribe改进了本地服务的开放量级模型,在8个度量衡上积分为6.2-59.4分,使其能够匹配或超越GPT-5.6-Sol等专有模型.

blocks.en: Recent advances in coding agents, exemplified by Claude Code ( Anthropic, ) and Codex ( OpenAI, ) , have extended their use beyond software engineering to a broader range of complex tasks ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Lyttelton et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Lyu et al., 2026 ) . These agents can select tools, generate and execute code, and revise their approach based on intermediate results, providing flexibility in how they organize and complete a task ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Ning et al., 2026 ) . Such capabilities make coding agents promising for long-document tasks, where relevant information may be distributed across many pages and different document structures may require different processing strategies. However, it remains unclear whether coding agents can reliably transform complex documents into accurate, complete, and structured outputs.
blocks.zh: 以克洛德编码(Anthropic,)和Codex(OpenAI,)为例的编码剂的近期进步,将其应用范围从软件工程扩大到了更广泛的复杂任务(Wang等,2026a;Lyttelton等,2026;Wang等,2026b;Lyu等,2026). 这些代理商可以选择工具,生成和执行代码,并根据中间结果修改其方法,在如何组织和完成一项任务方面提供灵活性(Wang等,2024;Ning等,2026). 这种能力使编码代理人对长文件任务有希望,因为有关信息可能分布在许多页上,不同的文件结构可能需要不同的处理战略。 然而,仍然不清楚编码代理人是否能够可靠地将复杂的文件转化为准确、完整和结构化的产出。

blocks.en: Clinical trial protocol digitization, which transforms protocol information into structured and machine-readable representations ( Huser et al., 2015 ; Babaeipour et al., 2026 ) , provides a high-stakes, real-world setting for investigating the capabilities and reliability of coding agents on long-document tasks. First, it is a representative long-document task. Clinical trial protocols specify the core design and operational requirements of a study, but are predominantly maintained as lengthy, unstructured PDF documents ( Chan et al., 2025 ; Babaeipour et al., 2026 ) . These documents contain heterogeneous layouts, complex tables, and information distributed across multiple sections, requiring systems to navigate long documents, integrate scattered evidence, and reconstruct structured relationships.
blocks.zh: 临床试验协议数字化(Huser等,2015;Babaeipour等,2026),将协议信息转化为结构化和机能可读的表述,为在长文件任务中调查编码剂的能力和可靠性提供了高取取取,现实世界的设定. 首先,这是一项具有代表性的长期文件任务。 临床试验规程具体规定了一项研究的核心设计和操作要求,但主要是作为冗长的、无结构的PDF文件加以保存(Chan等,2025;Babaeipour等,2026)。 这些文件包含不同的布局、复杂的表格和分布在多节的信息,要求系统导航长的文件、整合分散的证据并重建结构化的关系。

blocks.en: Second, it has direct practical value. When protocol requirements remain embedded in documents, they require repeated manual interpretation and translation into downstream systems, resulting in limited interoperability, reduced efficiency, and increased risk of inconsistencies and transcription errors ( Babaeipour et al., 2026 ; Boland et al., 2012 ) . Structured protocol representation is essential for making study requirements computable, interoperable, and reusable across the clinical trial life cycle ( Huser et al., 2015 ; Richardson and Genyn, 2025 ; Babaeipour et al., 2026 ) . Because these representations inform downstream trial operations, even small errors, such as altered eligibility thresholds or misplaced study activities, can change the intended study requirements.
blocks.zh: 第二,它具有直接的实际价值。 当协议要求仍然嵌入文件时,它们需要反复人工口译和翻译到下游系统,导致互操作性有限,效率降低,出现不一致和抄录错误的风险增加(Babaeipour等,2026;Boland等,2012.). 结构化的协议表述对于使研究要求可以计算、相互操作和在整个临床试验生命周期可重复使用至关重要(Huser等人,2015年;Richardson和Genyn,2025年;Babaeipour等人,2026年)。 因为这些陈述为下游审判业务提供了信息,即使是小错误,如资格阈值被改变或学习活动被错误地改变,也可能改变预期的研究要求.

Beyond final-answer performance, our evaluation protocol measures evidence recall from agent traces, agent behavior including vision use, tool errors, and interaction turns, and cost. Our contributions are as follows:

blocks.en: 2.1 Task Definition
blocks.zh: 2.1 任务定义

blocks.en: We formulate clinical trial protocol digitization as extracting information from a protocol PDF into structured JSON output. The task-specific output schemas are derived from Unified Study Definitions Model (USDM) v4.0 ( CDISC, ) . CDISC’s (Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium) USDM is an established standard to represent protocol documents into a structured machine-readable data. The output schemas cover selected portions relevant to four extraction tasks: disease indication, eligibility criteria, objectives and endpoints, and schedule of activities. The objective is to recover the relevant information in D D accurately and completely while conforming to the fields and structure specified by S t S_{t} .

blocks.en: 2.2 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 2.2 基准建设

blocks.en: We construct TrialPD - Bench from clinical trial source documents associated with 150 unique NCT (National Clinical Trial) identifiers. (1) Disease indication extraction identifies the disease or condition investigated in the study. (2) Eligibility criteria extraction recovers participant inclusion and exclusion criteria. (3) Objectives and endpoints extraction identifies study objectives and their associated endpoints, together with their respective levels. (4) Schedule of activities (SoA) includes SoA table extraction and structured timeline extraction: the former locates the SoA tables in the full protocol and recovers their activity-visit structure, while the latter extracts study epochs, encounters, and activities. Reference outputs were produced by five experts in the clinical trial domain (Appendix C.3 ). We hold out the protocols used to develop TrialScribe (§ 4 ) as a development split and report all results on the remaining test split.

blocks.en: 2.3 Overview and Statistics
blocks.zh: 2.3 概况和统计

blocks.en: Figure 2 summarizes the task categories and composition of the corpus, which comprises clinical trial source documents from ClinicalTrials.gov ( U.S. National Library of Medicine, ) , covering 18 therapeutic areas and 106 sponsors. Across these sponsors, the documents vary in section organization and table structure. For example, SoA tables may appear near the beginning of a protocol or in appendices, with different arrangements of study periods, visit windows, multi-level headers, and footnotes. This structural variation requires extraction systems to interpret information beyond fixed page positions or table layouts. In this dataset, protocol documents have a median length of 122 pages, with 98 documents (65.3%) containing at least 100 pages, and depending on the task, up to 31.5% of PDFs have task-relevant content that is missing from or garbled in the text layer and must be read from rendered pages (Appendix F.4 ). Table 1 reports the sample size and reference annotations of each task.

blocks.en: 2.4 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 2.4 评价计量

blocks.en: We evaluate coding agents along four dimensions: (1) Final-answer Performance , using each task’s scoring metrics to assess extraction quality; (2) Evidence Recall , using page recall to measure coverage of required evidence pages in observable agent traces; (3) Agent Behavior , measured by vision use rate on cases requiring visual recovery, average tool execution errors, and average agent response turns; and (4) Resource Usage , measured by average cost per run in USD. Detailed task specifications and evaluation metrics are provided in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 我们按照四个方面评价编码剂: (1) 最终回答性能,利用每项任务的分数衡量提取质量;(2) 证据回顾,利用页回调测量可观察到的物剂痕迹中所需证据页的覆盖范围;(3) 物剂行为,以需要视觉恢复的病例的视觉使用率、平均工具执行错误和平均物剂反应转折来衡量;和(4) 资源使用,以美元每跑的平均成本来衡量。 详细的任务规格和评价指标载于附录D。

blocks.en: Finding 1: Task difficulty varies widely, and even the strongest coding agents do not fully solve protocol digitization. Frontier agents largely handle tasks that mainly require locating and transcribing contiguous text or tables. The best agent reaches 87.8% F1 on eligibility criteria, 86.8% Activity-Visit F1 on SoA tables, 85.0% indication F1, and 84.9% objective F1. Components that require linking information across sections or mapping it onto the study design are considerably harder. The best endpoint F1 is 67.4% and the best objective-linked endpoint F1 is 58.7%, both well below objective F1. On structured timelines, agents recover activities with up to 91.1% recall, yet epoch accuracy peaks at 73.3% and encounter recall at 23.2%, and the three Opus agents recover no reference encounter. The gaps between models also depend on the task. On eligibility criteria, seven agents lie within 1.4 points of each other (86.4–87.8%), whereas Activity-Visit F1 on SoA tables ranges from 32.5% to 86.8%. Apart from timeline activity recall, no final-answer metric exceeds 88%. Because extracted study definitions feed directly into downstream trial systems, the remaining errors are consequential. Directly deploying current frontier coding agents therefore does not yet provide complete and reliable protocol digitization, and the largest gaps lie in the relational components of a protocol rather than in its surface content.
blocks.zh: 查找 1:任务难度相差很大,即使是最强的编码代理也无法完全解决协议数字化问题. 边境代理人主要处理主要需要查找和转录毗连文本或表格的任务。 最佳代理商按资格标准达到87.8%的F1,SoA表中的86.8%的活动-Visit F1,85.0%表示F1,84.9%的目标F1. 需要将各科之间的信息联系起来或将信息映射到研究设计上的部分要困难得多。 最佳端点F1为67.4%,最佳目标关联端点F1为58.7%,两者都远低于目标F1. 在有条理的时间安排上,特工回收活动,回收率高达91.1%,然而,划时代准确率高峰为73.3%,遇召率为23.2%,3名奥普斯特工没有回收任何参考资料。 模型之间的差距也取决于任务。 关于资格标准,有7名代理人在1.4分之内(86.4%-87.8%),而SoA表中的活动-视觉F1从32.5%到86.8%不等。 除了时间活动召回之外,最后答复的尺度不超过88%。 由于所提取的研究定义直接反馈到下游试验系统,所余出错是相继发生的. 因此,直接部署现有的前沿编码剂尚不能提供完整和可靠的协议数字化,最大的空白在于协议的关系部分,而不是其表面内容。

blocks.en: Finding 2: Locating the evidence is not the main bottleneck, and high evidence recall does not translate into accurate extraction. Agents generally reach the pages that contain the required evidence. Except for Kimi-K3 on objectives and endpoints (72.4%), the seven frontier agents visit at least 84.8% of the required evidence pages on every task. Final-answer performance, however, does not follow evidence recall. The clearest case is structured timelines, where every agent visits at least 98.3% of the evidence pages, yet encounter recall stays at or below 23.2%. Across models, visiting more evidence pages does not yield better extraction. Opus 4.6 has the highest SoA evidence recall of any agent (96.0%) but reaches only 54.7% Activity-Visit F1, whereas GPT-6-Astra has the lowest among frontier agents (84.8%) and achieves the best score (86.8%). Similarly, Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 5 visit every indication evidence page yet reach 67.5% and 75.0% F1, below Opus 5 at 85.0% with 92.5% evidence recall. Across the seven frontier agents, the ranking by evidence recall does not track the ranking by final-answer performance. The main bottleneck therefore lies after localization: agents must read the evidence faithfully and reconstruct its structure, which we analyze in § 3.2 .
blocks.zh: 调查结果2:查找证据不是主要瓶颈,高证据召回不能转化为准确提取. 代理人通常到达载有所需证据的页面。 除了关于目标和终点的Kimi-K3(72.4%)外,7名边防人员至少访问84.8%的每项任务所需证据页。 然而,最后答复的表现并不取决于证据的召回。 最清楚的案件是结构化的时间表,每名代理人至少访问98.3%的证据页,但被召回的时间保持在23.2%或以下。 在整个模型中,访问更多的证据网页并不能产生更好的提取。 Opus 4.6具有最高的SoA证据召回任何代理(96.0%),但只达到54.7%的活动-Visit F1,而GPT-6-Astra在边境代理中最低(84.8%),并达到最佳分数(86.8%). 同样,Opus 4.6和Sonnet 5访问每个指示证据页的频率分别为67.5%和75.0%,低于Opus 5的频率为85.0%,92.5%的证据被召回。 在7名边境特工中,通过证据召回的排名没有通过最后的回答表现跟踪排名。 因此,主要的瓶颈在于本地化之后:代理人必须忠实地阅读证据并重建其结构,我们在第3.2节中对此进行了分析。

blocks.en: Finding 3: Tool errors and interaction turns scale with task complexity. Agent behavior varies systematically across tasks (Table 3 ). Averaged over the nine agents, indication extraction takes 7.1 turns and incurs 0.55 tool errors per run, whereas SoA table extraction takes 39.8 turns and incurs 2.18 errors, a 5.6-fold and 4.0-fold increase, respectively. The average number of turns rises from indication (7.1) to eligibility criteria (16.6), objectives and endpoints (19.1), structured timelines (21.5), and SoA tables (39.8). This order follows the structural complexity of the output. Weaker models amplify this effect. DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Qwen3.8-27B incur 2.64–5.69 tool errors per run on objectives and endpoints and on SoA tables, compared with at most 2.19 for the frontier agents. They also obtain visual evidence less often when it is required (42.9–75.0%, Table 4 ), whereas every frontier agent does so in at least 67.9% of such cases and in all SoA cases. Longer trajectories do not produce better answers. On SoA tables, Sonnet 5 takes 69.4 turns to reach 74.7% Activity-Visit F1, while GPT-6-Astra reaches 86.8% in 16.0 turns. Turns and errors therefore indicate task difficulty and execution reliability rather than extraction quality.
blocks.zh: 发现 3: 工具出错和相互作用会随着任务的复杂性而转向规模. 代理行为因任务而有系统差异(表3). 平均在9个剂中,表示抽取需要7.1个转弯并每跑一次发生0.55个工具出错,而SoA表取出需要39.8个转弯并发生2.18个出错,分别增加5.6倍和4.0倍。 平均转弯次数从表示(7.1)增至资格标准(16.6)、目标和终点(19.1)、结构化时间表(21.5)和索阿表(39.8)。 这一顺序遵循了产出的结构复杂性. 疲软的模型放大了这种效果. DeepSeek-V4-Flash和Qune3.8-27B在目标和终点以及SoA表格上每跑一次发生2.64-5.69个工具出错,而边境代理最多为2.19个。 在需要时,他们也获得较少的视觉证据(42.9-75.0%,表4),而在至少67.9%的此类案件中,在所有 " 团结 " 案件中,每个边境代理人都这样做。 较长的轨迹不会产生更好的答案. 在SoA表上,Sonnet 5需要69.4个转弯,达到74.7%的活动-Visit F1,而GPT-6-Astra在16.0个转弯中达到86.8%. 因此,转弯和出错表明任务难度和执行可靠性,而不是提取质量。

blocks.en: Finding 4: Similar final-answer performance can come at very different costs. Because agents differ in both trajectory length and token price, comparable accuracy can carry very different costs (Table 5 ). On eligibility criteria, the seven frontier agents lie within 1.4 F1 points of each other, while the cost per run ranges from $0.40 (Sonnet 5) to $1.35 (GPT-6-Astra), a 3.4-fold difference. Kimi-K3 (86.9%, $0.44) and GPT-5.6-Sol (87.1%, $0.50) are both within one point of the best agent at about a third of its cost. On SoA tables, GPT-5.6-Sol reaches 83.7% Activity-Visit F1 at $0.85 per run, within 3.1 points of GPT-6-Astra at 40% of its cost ($2.13). In contrast, Opus 4.6 is the most expensive agent on this task ($4.49) yet scores only 54.7%. On objectives and endpoints, Kimi-K3 attains the highest objective F1 (84.9%) at $0.63 per run, below GPT-6-Astra ($1.07) and Opus 4.6 ($1.16). DeepSeek-V4-Flash marks the low-cost extreme: it reaches 80.2% criteria F1 at $0.04 per run, 34 times cheaper than GPT-6-Astra. Cost is thus not a proxy for quality. For tasks on which frontier agents perform similarly, substantially cheaper configurations can be chosen with little loss in performance.
blocks.zh: 发现4:类似的最终答案性能可以以非常不同的成本产生. 由于物剂在轨距和象征性价格上都不同,可比的精度可以承担非常不同的成本(表5. 就资格标准而言,7名边境代理人在彼此1.4个F1分之内,而每次运行的费用从0.40美元(Sonnet 5)到1.35美元(GPT-6-Astra)不等,相差3.4倍. Kimi-K3(86.9%,0.44美元)和GPT-5.6-Sol(87.1%,0.50美元)均在最佳剂的一分之内,成本约为其三分之一。 在SoA表中,GPT-5.6-Sol在GPT-6-Astra的3.1分内,以每跑0.85美元的价格(2.13美元)达到83.7%的活动-视觉F1。 相比之下,Opus 4.6是这一任务最昂贵的代理商(4.49美元),但得分却只有54.7%. 关于目标和终点,Kimi-K3达到了最高目标F1(84.9%),每跑0.63美元,低于GPT-6-Astra (1.07)和Opus 4.6 (1.16)。 DeepSeek-V4-Flash标志着低成本的极端:它以每跑0.04美元达到80.2%的标准F1,比GPT-6-Astra便宜了34倍. 因此,成本不是质量的代名词。 对于边境人员同样执行的任务,可以选择便宜得多的配置,而不会造成业绩损失。

blocks.en: Takeaways. • Frontier coding agents reliably locate protocol evidence and recover much of its surface content, but still fall short on relational structure such as endpoint linkage and study timelines. • Turns and tool errors vary with the task and peak on SoA tables, but within a task, longer trajectories are not associated with higher accuracy. • When agents perform similarly, cheaper configurations can deliver comparable accuracy.
blocks.zh: Takeaides. • 边境编码剂可靠地定位协议证据并取回大部分表面内容,但在端点连接和研究时间表等关系结构上仍然不足. • 转弯和工具出错随任务和SoA表上的峰值而异,但在任务范围内,较长的轨迹与更高的准确性无关。 当物剂进行类似操作时,更便宜的配置可以提供可比较的准确性.

blocks.en: 3 Further Analysis
blocks.zh: 3 进一步分析

blocks.en: This section examines how agent performance changes across model releases and where agents fail. Appendix F reports further analyses, including comparisons with OCR and document-understanding models and with a RAG pipeline, eligibility criteria by category, and results by PDF text accessibility.
blocks.zh: 本节审查剂性能如何在模型释放中发生改变,以及剂失效之处。 附 录 F报告进一步分析,包括与OCR和文档理解模型以及RAG管道的比较,按类别分列的资格标准,以及PDF文本可访问性的结果。

blocks.en: 3.1 Performance across Model Releases
blocks.zh: 3.1 模型发布时的表现

blocks.en: Figure 3: SoA Activity-Visit F1 on complete protocols (Table 2 ) against model release date. Lines connect models of the same family; hollow markers denote open-weight models.
blocks.zh: 图3:关于完整协议的SoA活动-Visit F1(表2)与模型发布日期相对. 线条连接同家族的模型;空心标记表示开重模型.

blocks.en: We analyze how SoA table extraction performance changes across model releases, plotting document-level Activity-Visit F1 against each model’s release date (Figure 3 ). Performance improves quickly within model families: Opus rises from 54.7% for Opus 4.6 (February 2026) to 86.0% for Opus 5 (July 2026). Since July, frontier agents have clustered between 83.7% and 86.8%, still short of full accuracy. Open-weight models released in the same period diverge: Kimi-K3 (83.9%) matches proprietary agents, whereas DeepSeek-V4-Flash (47.5%) and Qwen3.8-27B (32.5%) fall far behind.
blocks.zh: 我们分析SoA表格提取性能如何在模型发布时发生改变, 模范家庭的业绩迅速改善: 奥普斯从Apus 4.6(2026年2月)的54.7%上升到了Apus 5(2026年7月)的86.0%. 自兹 7月,边境特工的组分在83.7%至86.8%之间,仍然不足完全准确. 同期发布的开放量级模型有差异:Kimi-K3(83.9%)匹配专有剂,而DeepSeek-V4-Flash(47.5%)和Qune3.8-27B(32.5%)则远远落后。

blocks.en: 3.2 Failure Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.2 失败分析

blocks.en: Figure 4: Failure analysis across protocol digitization tasks. (a) Each pie shows the distribution of failure categories among failing runs within one task; labels indicate shares of at least 8%. (b) Illustrative examples of the five main failure categories, with incorrect or missing predictions highlighted in red.
blocks.zh: 图 4: 协议数字化任务的失败分析. 每个馅饼显示失败类别在一个任务内运行的失败类别之间的分布情况;标签显示至少8%的股份。 (b) 5个主要故障类别的说明性实例,以红色突出显示不正确或缺失的预测。

blocks.en: To understand where coding agents fail, we classify each failing agent run, defined as a run with at least one detected defect. These failures fall mainly into five categories: transcription fidelity, long-document localization and coverage, relational structure reconstruction, domain concept grounding, and execution reliability. As Figure 4 a shows, the dominant failure category differs markedly across tasks.
blocks.zh: 为了了解编码代理失败之处,我们把每一个失败代理运行分类,定义为至少有一个被检测出缺陷的运行. 这些失败主要分为五类:转录忠实、长文件本地化和覆盖、关系结构重建、域名概念定位和执行可靠性。 如图4a所示,主要失败类别因任务而异。

blocks.en: For eligibility criteria, transcription fidelity accounts for 88.0% of failing runs: agents locate and read the eligibility section but do not reproduce it exactly. These deviations can change the clinical meaning. Among near-verbatim transcriptions, 167 alter a comparison operator and 308 alter a number, for example rendering “ ≥ \geq 100 meters” as “ > > 100 meters” (Figure 4 b). For indication extraction, domain concept grounding is the largest category (51.7%), reflecting failures to identify the condition under study. DeepSeek-V4-Flash, for example, returns “Non-Valvular Atrial Fibrillation” for a study whose indication is recurrent embolic stroke. For objectives and endpoints, localization and coverage account for a substantial share (26.7%), because endpoints are distributed across the synopsis, main text, and tables. For SoA tables, relational structure accounts for 58.9% of failing runs, most often because agents reconstruct the table but place scheduling marks in the wrong cells; a single misresolved merged cell can shift every subsequent mark on a page. Most of the remaining failing runs (37.5%) are localization failures, in which agents miss the annotated SoA pages.
blocks.zh: 就资格标准而言,转录忠诚占失败运行的88.0%:代理查找和阅读资格部分,但不确切转载。 这些偏差可以改变临床意义. 在近村字抄录中,167个更改了比较操作员,308个更改了数字,例如将“≥\ geq 100米”改为“ > > 100米”(图4b)。 为表示提取,域名概念定位是最大的类别(51.7%),反映了未能识别所研究的条件。 例如,DeepSeek-V4-Flash返回“非Valvular Arition Fibrilation”,用于一项研究,其迹象是反复出现的浮雕中风。 就目标和终点而言,本地化和覆盖范围占很大份额(26.7%),因为终点分布在概要、正文和表格中。 对于"SoA"表格,关系结构占失败运行的58.9%,最常的原因是代理重构表格但将调度标记放入错误的单元格;单个被错误地解析后被合并的单元格可以在一页上转移后的每一个标记. 所剩大部分故障运行(37.5%)是本地化故障,其中代理商会错过附加注释的"SoA"页面.

blocks.en: Structured timeline extraction is dominated by domain concept grounding (65.2%): agents often identify the right visits but do not describe them with the expected encounter categories. Although the task instruction explicitly asks agents to follow USDM v4.0, they do not apply its controlled terminology, suggesting that agents recognize the standard but lack knowledge of its detailed specifications. Execution reliability, by contrast, accounts for at most 3.6% of failing runs in any task: the nine agents almost always produce usable output, and their errors lie in its content.
blocks.zh: 结构化的时间线提取以域名概念定位为主(65.2%):代理商经常识别正确的访问,但没有用预期的相遇类别来描述. 虽然任务指示明确要求代理人遵循USDM v 4.0,但他们并不应用其受控术语,说明代理人承认标准,但不了解其详细规格。 相比之下,执行可靠性在任何任务中最多占失败运行的3.6%:这九名代理人几乎总是产生可用产出,其错误在于其内容。

blocks.en: 4 TrialScribe : A Domain-Specific Harness for Protocol Digitization
blocks.zh: 4 TrialScribe : 用于协议数字化的域-特定工具

blocks.en: Our analysis points to two practical obstacles. First, protocols are often confidential, which favors compact open-weight models (e.g., Qwen3.8-27B) that run locally in private environments, yet these models fall behind proprietary agents (§ 3.1 ). Second, most failures arise after the evidence is found, from unfaithful transcription, misplaced structure, and unfamiliar domain conventions (§ 3.2 ). We therefore introduce TrialScribe , a domain-specific harness layer that equips an existing coding agent with task skills, which supply domain knowledge and output conventions, and a verification loop, which audits the output against the source. We examine whether TrialScribe allows a locally served open-weight model to match proprietary coding agents.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析指出了两个实际障碍。 首先,协议常常是保密的,它倾向于在私人环境中在当地运行的紧凑的开量模型(例如Quen3.8-27B),但这些模型落后于专有代理(第3.1节). 第二,在发现证据后,大多数失败都产生于不忠实的抄录、错误的结构以及不熟悉的域公约(第3.2节)。 因此,我们引入了TrimeScribe,这是一个针对特定域的带子层,它使一个现有的编码代理人具备任务技能,提供域知识和输出常规,以及一个对照源对输出进行审计的核查循环。 我们审查TrimeScribe是否允许一个本地服务的开量模型匹配专有编码剂.

blocks.en: 4.1 Design
blocks.zh: 4.1 设计

blocks.en: Task skills. For each task, TrialScribe provides a skill, a SKILL.md file placed in the agent’s environment and registered with the harness. The agent reads it at the start of the task and then decides when and how to apply its guidance and tools as it works. Each skill encodes the domain knowledge and working procedures that the task requires: how protocols typically organize and cross-reference the relevant information, which conventions determine a correct output, and which checks confirm that the output is complete and faithful to the source.
blocks.zh: 任务技能. 对于每一项任务,TrialScribe都提供一种技能,一个SKILL.md文件,放在代理商的环境下,并登记在吊带上。 代理商在任务开始时读取,然后决定何时以及如何在工作过程中应用其指导和工具. 每种技能都对任务需要的域名知识和工作程序编码:协议一般如何组织和交叉参考相关信息,哪些公约决定正确的输出,哪些检查确认输出是完整和忠实于源的.

blocks.en: Verification loop. After the agent writes a draft, a fresh agent session audits it against the protocol with read-only access to both the protocol and the candidate output. The auditor reports concrete errors together with their source pages and suggested corrections, and a gold-free gate checks the report for schema validity and internal consistency. If errors remain, the agent applies minimal source-supported fixes, and the revised output is audited again, for at most two rounds. For SoA table extraction, the agent instead verifies its output within its own session (Appendix H.3 ).
blocks.zh: 核查环. 在代理撰写草稿后,一个新鲜的代理会话根据协议进行审核,只读访问协议和候选输出. 审计员报告具体错误及其来源页,并建议更正,并检查报告是否具有计划有效性和内部一致性。 如果错误仍然存在,代理机构将采用最低限度的源支持的修补方法,并且修改后的产出将再次审计,最多两轮。 对于SoA表提取,代理在自己的会话内验证其输出(附录H.3.).

blocks.en: 4.2 Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 结果

blocks.en: We instantiate TrialScribe with Qwen3.8-27B and Pi harness, served locally on two NVIDIA A100 GPUs.
blocks.zh: 我们用Quen3.8-27B和Pi cape来即时审判Scribe,在当地服务于两个NVIDIA A100 GPU.

blocks.en: TrialScribe narrows the gap between a locally served agent and proprietary coding agents. As Figure 1 (e) shows, TrialScribe improves Qwen3.8-27B on every evaluated task, e.g., 15.2% on eligibility criteria F1, 22.2% on objective F1, 18.8% on endpoint F1, and by 37.1% on epoch accuracy, 6.2% on activity recall, and 59.4% on encounter recall. With TrialScribe , the local model surpasses GPT-5.6-Sol on endpoint extraction (65.5% vs. 63.6%) and comes within 1.9% of Opus-5 on endpoints. On timeline extraction, it exceeds both proprietary agents on activity recall (88.6% vs. 88.1% and 87.2%) and encounter recall (65.2% vs. 23.2% and 0.0%), and trails GPT-5.6-Sol on epoch accuracy (60.0% vs. 61.1%).
blocks.zh: TrialScribe缩小了本地服务代理和专有编码代理之间的间隔. 如图1(e)所示,TrialScribe改进了Qune3.8-27B 在每项评估任务中,例如:资格标准F1为15.2%,目标F1为22.2%,终点F1为18.8%,时间准确度为37.1%,活动召回为6.2%,遭遇召回为59.4%。 随着TrialScribe 的出现,本地型号在取出端点时超过了GPT-5.6-Sol(65.5%对63.6%),在取出端点时达到Opus-5的1.9%。 在取出时间线时,活性召回(88.6%对88.1%和87.2%)和遇到召回(65.2%对23.2%和0.0%)的专有制剂都超过了专有制剂,在时间线精确度上跟踪GPT-5.6-Sol(60.0%对61.1%)。

blocks.en: Verification helps most where transcription fidelity dominates. Comparing the draft and final outputs of the same runs, we find that verification raises eligibility criteria F1 from 72.2% to 82.3%, objective F1 from 73.2% to 78.2%, and endpoint F1 from 62.0% to 65.5%, but leaves indication F1 unchanged at 77.5%. This pattern mirrors the failure profiles in Figure 4 : eligibility criteria fail mainly through transcription errors that a source-grounded audit can detect.
blocks.zh: 核实在记录忠诚占主导地位的地方最有帮助。 比较草案和最终产出,我们发现核查将资格标准F1从72.2%提高到82.3%,目标F1从73.2%提高到78.2%,终点F1从62.0%提高到65.5%,但F1没有变化,为77.5%。 这个模式在图4中反映了失败配置: 资格标准失败主要通过一个来源依据的审计能够发现的抄录错误.

blocks.en: Structural and standard-specific gaps remain, but they are likely to narrow as open-weight models improve. On SoA tables, TrialScribe reaches 75.1% Activity-Visit F1 and 78.6% Sub/sup F1, but still trails GPT-5.6-Sol and Opus 5 in Activity-Visit F1 (75.1% vs. 83.7% and 86.0%), suggesting that reconstructing complex table structure remains limited by the underlying model. Nevertheless, open-weight models have improved rapidly ( Edwards and Emberson, 2026 ) , and because TrialScribe does not rely on a particular model, it can be applied directly to stronger ones, which we expect to close the remaining gaps.
blocks.zh: 结构和具体标准的差距依然存在,但随着开放重量模式的改善,这些差距有可能缩小。 在SoA表格上,TrialScribe达到了75.1%的活动-Visit F1和78.6%的Sub/sup F1,但仍跟随GPT-5.6-Sol和Opus 5在活动-Visit F1中(75.1%对83.7%和86.0%),这表明重建复杂的表格结构仍然受到基本模型的限制. 尽管如此,开放量级模型得到了迅速的改进(Edwards and Emberson, 2026),由于TrievScribe并不依赖于特定模型,因此可以直接应用于更强大的模型,我们期望这些模型能弥合所剩的空白.

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: Prior work on protocol digitization structures eligibility criteria for cohort queries ( Kang et al., 2017 ; Yuan et al., 2019 ; Park et al., 2024 ) or interprets schedule-of-activities tables ( Dhuliawala et al., 2018 ; Kumar et al., 2024 ) , mostly on registry text; Babaeipour et al. (2026) cover all four categories with a RAG system on 23 unreleased protocols. Document parsers ( Cui et al., 2025a ; Poznanski et al., 2025 ) and benchmarks ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) evaluate layout recovery and schema-guided extraction, while coding agents ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Soni et al., 2026 ) and agent skills ( Li et al., 2026 ) increasingly reach beyond software engineering. See Appendix B for more details.
blocks.zh: 此前关于组群查询协议数字化结构合格标准的工作(Kang等,2017;Yuan等,2019;Park等,2024)或解释活动时间表表(Dhuliawala等,2018;Kumar等,2024),多见于登记文本;Babaeipour等(2026),涵盖所有四类,其中23个未释放协议的RAG系统. 文件解析器(Cui等,2025年a;Ponzinski等,2025年)和基准(Oyang等,2025年;Zhang等,2026年)评价布局恢复和由计划指导的取出,而编码剂(Wang等,2024年;Yang等,2024年;Soni等,2026年)和代理技能(Li等,2026年)则日益超出软件工程的范围. 见附录 更多细节请见B.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduce TrialPD - Bench and find that even the strongest coding agents usually locate the required evidence but fail in the last mile of transcribing and structuring it. We further develop TrialScribe , which enables a locally served open-weight model to match or surpass proprietary agents such as GPT-5.6-Sol.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了审判警察(TrialPD)——法官,发现即使是最强的编码人员也通常能找到所需的证据,但在翻录和结构的最后一英里中却失败了. 我们进一步开发了TrimeScribe,它使得当地服务的开放量级模型能够匹配或超越GPT-5.6-Sol等专有代理.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: We use clinical trial protocol digitization as a testbed for studying coding agents on long-document tasks, so our findings are bounded by this setting. At the same time, the properties that make protocols challenging, namely their length, heterogeneous layouts, complex tables, and information distributed across sections, are shared by many other long documents, such as regulatory filings, contracts, and technical specifications. We therefore expect some of our findings, in particular that agents usually locate the required evidence but lose accuracy when transcribing and structuring it, to be informative beyond this setting.
blocks.zh: 我们使用临床试验协议数字化作为测试台来研究长文件任务中的编码剂,因此我们的结论以这个设定为界限. 同时,使协议具有挑战性的性质,即长度、布局不同、表格复杂和在各节之间分发的信息,也为许多其他冗长的文件所分享,如规章文件、合同和技术规格。 因此,我们期望我们的一些调查结果,特别是代理人通常找到所需证据,但在转录和整理证据时会失去准确性,从而超出这一范围而提供信息。

blocks.en: Moreover, structured timeline extraction remains challenging for current coding agents, and our evaluation of this task includes only three protocols. The structured timeline also underlies many downstream tasks, such as main and sub timeline extraction, which are beyond the scope of this paper.
blocks.zh: 此外,对目前的编码代理人而言,结构化的时间表提取仍然具有挑战性,我们对这项任务的评估只包括三项协议。 结构化的时间表也是许多下游任务的基础,如主要和分时间表提取,超出了本文件的范围.

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: All protocol documents in TrialPD - Bench are publicly available on ClinicalTrials.gov, and we use them as released without collecting any additional data. The reference annotations were produced by the authors; no external annotators were recruited or compensated, and the work involves no human-subject research. We do not foresee significant ethical risks from this work.
blocks.zh: 审判警察-法官室的所有协议文件均可在Comical Critics.gov上公开查阅,我们使用这些协议文件时没有收集任何补充数据。 参考说明由作者编写;没有聘用或补偿任何外部注释员,而且该作品不涉及人文研究。 我们没有预见到这项工作带来的重大道德风险。

blocks.en: A.1 Coding Agents
blocks.zh: A.1 编码代理人

blocks.en: A coding agent combines a language model with an agent harness. The model interprets task instructions, reasons over the available context, and generates code or tool calls. The harness is the surrounding software infrastructure that manages instructions and context, provides tool interfaces, and coordinates interaction with the execution environment. Typical tools support file access, search, edit, and code execution, while the harness manages the execution loop and associated controls.
blocks.zh: 编码代理结合了语言模型和代理吊带. 该模型在可用上下文中解释任务指令,理由,并生成代码或工具调用. 取用是周围的软件基础设施,管理指令和上下文,提供工具界面,并协调与执行环境的相互作用. 典型的工具支持文件访问,搜索,编辑和代码执行,而被控制器则管理执行循环和相关控制.

blocks.en: These components operate through an iterative interaction loop: the model selects an action, the harness executes the corresponding tool call and returns its result. The model then uses this feedback to determine subsequent actions. This process continues until the agent produces a final response or an execution limit is reached. The resulting behavior depends on both the underlying model and the harness that provides the operational layer for the model.
blocks.zh: 这些组件通过迭代交互循环运行:模型选择一个动作,被套用执行相应的工具调用并返回结果. 模型然后使用这种反馈来确定随后的行动. 这一过程一直持续到代理人作出最后回应或执行限制. 由此产生的行为既取决于基本模型,也取决于为模型提供操作层的牵引.

blocks.en: Appendix B Additional Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录B 相关工作

blocks.en: Research on protocol digitization spans semantic parsing, supervised extraction, and LLM-based methods. EliIE ( Kang et al., 2017 ) and Criteria2Query ( Yuan et al., 2019 ) transform eligibility text into structured representations for clinical database querying, while BERT-based approaches learn clinically relevant entities and relations ( Chen et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2021 ) . Chia ( Kury et al., 2020 ) and LCT ( Dobbins et al., 2022 ) provide annotated registry eligibility text for developing these capabilities. AutoCriteria ( Datta et al., 2024 ) and Criteria2Query 3.0 ( Park et al., 2024 ) subsequently introduce LLMs for criteria extraction and query generation. Beyond eligibility, Dhuliawala et al. (2018) interpret schedule-of-activities tables through structural and semantic analysis, and Kumar et al. (2024) study schedule-of-event table detection. Babaeipour et al. (2026) address broader extraction from complete protocol PDFs through a RAG system. Our work complements these approaches by evaluating general-purpose coding agents across multiple protocol extraction tasks and diagnosing their remaining failures.
blocks.zh: 关于协议数字化的研究涉及语义解析、监督提取和基于LLM的方法。 EliIE(Kang等,2017年)和"标准2查询"(Yuan等,2019年)将资格文本转化为临床数据库查询的有条理表述,而基于BERT的方法学习临床相关实体和关系(Chen等,2020年;Liu等,2021年). Chia (Kury等人,2020年)和LCT (Dobbins等人,2022年)为开发这些能力提供了附加说明的登记册资格文本. 自动标准 (Datta等人,2024年)和标准2Query 3.0(Park等人,2024年)后来引入了LLMs,用于标准提取和查询生成. 除了资格之外,Dhuliawala等人(2018年)通过结构和语义分析来解释活动表,Kumar等人(2024年)研究活动表检测。 Babaeipour等人(2026年)通过RAG系统从完整的协议PDF中进行更广泛的提取。 我们的工作补充了这些方法,对多种协议提取任务的通用编码剂进行评价,并诊断其剩余的故障。

blocks.en: Document understanding research addresses the recovery of text, layout, and tabular structure from heterogeneous documents. PubTables-1M ( Smock et al., 2022 ) supports table detection and structure recognition, while OmniDocBench ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ) evaluates document parsing across diverse layouts and content types. Recent models, including PaddleOCR-VL ( Cui et al., 2025a ) and olmOCR 2 ( Poznanski et al., 2025 ) , advance these parsing capabilities. At the document-processing level, DocAgent ( Sun et al., 2025 ) combines interactive navigation with evidence review. ExtractBench ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) further evaluates schema-guided enterprise extraction, including coding agents. Our benchmark focuses on clinical protocol requirements, evaluating document recovery, the application of domain knowledge, and the extraction of study concepts and relationships, including activity-visit associations and objective-endpoint links.
blocks.zh: 文件理解研究涉及从各种文件取回文本、版式和表格结构。 Pubtables-1M(Smock等,2022年)支持表检测和结构识别,而OmniDoc Bench(Ouyang等,2025年)则评价文档分解不同布局和内容类型. 最近的模型包括PaddleOCR-VL(Cui等,2025a)和olmOCR 2(Ponzinski等,2025年),推进了这些解析能力. 在文件处理层面,DocAgent(Sun等人,2025年)将交互式导航与证据审查相结合. Extract Bench (Zhang等,2026)进一步评价了包括编码剂在内的有计划制导的企业提取. 我们的基准侧重于临床协议要求、评估文件恢复、应用域名知识以及提取研究概念和关系,包括活动访问协会和目标-终点链接。

blocks.en: CodeAct ( Wang et al., 2024 ) and SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) demonstrate the importance of executable actions and agent-computer interfaces for interactive problem solving. OpenHands-Versa ( Soni et al., 2026 ) further investigates how coding agents equipped with general tools transfer across software engineering, research, and browsing tasks. Domain support is explored through plugins and examples in TaskWeaver ( Qiao et al., 2023 ) , and through clinical programming skills in ClinAgent ( Yan, 2026 ) . SkillsBench ( Li et al., 2026 ) evaluates the benefits of curated skills across domains, while Self-Refine ( Madaan et al., 2023 ) and Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) investigate feedback-guided revision and adaptation. Building on these directions, we examine coding-agent reliability in clinical trial protocol digitization and introduce TrialScribe , which combines domain skills with a verification loop.
blocks.zh: 代码Act(Wang等,2024年)和SWE代理(Yang等,2024年)证明了可执行动作和代理-计算机接口对于交互式解决问题的重要性. 打开 手 - 维尔萨 (Soni等,2026)进一步调查了如何在软件工程,研究和浏览任务之间,装备有一般工具的编码代理. 域名支持通过"TaskWeaver"(Qiao等,2023年)的插件和实例来探索,通过"ClinAgent"(Yan,2026年)的临床编程技能来探索. 技能 教席(Li等,2026年)评价了跨领域的受训技能的好处,而自读(Madaan等,2023年)和Reflexion(Shinn等,2023年)则调查了反馈指导的修订和适应. 在这些方向的基础上,我们研究了临床试验协议数字化中的编码代理可靠性,并引入了TrialScribe,将域技能与验证循环相结合.

blocks.en: The corpus consists of clinical trial protocol documents associated with 150 unique NCT identifiers on ClinicalTrials.gov ( U.S. National Library of Medicine, ) . Each task uses the subset of studies for which reference annotations are available, so a study can contribute to several tasks (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 该书目包括临床试验协议文件,与150种独特的NCT识别资料有关,载于 Clinicalvisiters.gov (美国国家医学图书馆,.). 每项任务使用有参考说明的研究子集,因此一项研究可以促进几项任务(表1.

blocks.en: The 150 representative documents contain 17,471 pages in total, with a median of 122 pages and a range of 2 to 368 pages. Ninety-eight documents (65.3%) contain at least 100 pages, five contain at least 200 pages, and five contain fewer than 20 pages. Sixteen documents (10.7%) have no extractable text layer, so their content can be recovered only from rendered pages or OCR.
blocks.zh: 150份代表性文件共17 471页,中位数为122页,2至368页不等。 98个文件(65.3%)至少包含100页,5个文件至少包含200页,5个文件不足20页。 16个文档(10.7%)没有可提取的文本层,因此其内容只能从已提供页面或OCR中取出.

blocks.en: We categorize each study by its primary indication using therapeutic-area categories adapted from the FDA’s Spectrum of Diseases/Conditions ( U.S. Food and Drug Administration, ) . Assignments follow the principal studied indication and trial intent rather than exclusions, drug mechanism, or sponsor; tumor-directed therapy, including hematologic malignancy, maps to Oncology, and prevention trials map to the disease being prevented. The 150 studies populate 18 FDA categories, and two healthy-volunteer studies without a disease-specific target are reported separately. Sponsor names are taken from registry metadata; after merging duplicate spellings of the same sponsor name, the corpus contains 106 sponsor labels.
blocks.zh: 我们使用FDA的病谱(美国食品和药品管理局,)的治疗领域类别,将每项研究按主要指标分类。 任务遵循主要研究指示和试验意图,而不是排除、药物机制或赞助者;肿瘤指导疗法,包括血液恶性肿瘤;肿瘤学地图;预防试验地图。 150项研究包含18个FDA类别,以及两个没有特定疾病目标的健康志愿研究分别报告。 赞助商的名字取自登记元数据;在合并同一赞助商名字的重复拼写后,该实体有106个赞助商标签。

blocks.en: C.3 Annotation Process
blocks.zh: C.3 注释过程

blocks.en: Reference annotations were produced by five experts in the clinical trial domain. Each task was annotated and reviewed separately, on its own set of protocols, so the number of instances differs across tasks (Table 1 ). For each protocol and task, Sonnet-4.6 running in Claude Code first produced a draft extraction from the source PDF, which served only as a starting point. An expert then checked every field of the draft against the PDF, corrected errors, added missing items, and removed unsupported ones. Verbatim fields were taken from the PDF text, or read from the rendered page when the text layer was missing or corrupted, and no draft text was kept without being checked against the source. The lead annotator then reviewed each annotated protocol against the PDF and made the final decision whenever the annotation needed to be changed. This process was used for all tasks except the epochs, encounters, and activities of structured timeline extraction, whose references are taken from the official USDM example studies published by CDISC ( CDISC, ) .
blocks.zh: 临床试验领域的五名专家编写了参考说明。 每项任务都是根据自己的一套协议单独附加说明和审查的,因此不同任务的实例数量不同(表1)。 对于每一个协议和任务,Sonnet-4.6运行于克洛德代码,首先从源代码PDF中提取出草稿,这仅仅是一个起点. 然后,一名专家对照PDF对草案的每个领域进行了检查,纠正了错误,增加了缺失的项目,并删除了不支持的项目. 平面字段取自PDF文本,或者在文本层缺失或被损坏时从已读取的页面中读取,任何文本草稿如果不与来源核对,都无法保存. 然后,首席注释员对照PDF审查了每个附加说明的协议,并在需要修改注释时作出最后决定。 这一过程用于所有任务,除了时代、相会和结构化时间表提取活动,其参考文献取自CDSC(CDIC, )发表的USDM正式实例研究。

blocks.en: Each task has its own annotation guideline. Table 7 lists the steps that annotators followed: general steps that familiarize the annotator with the study, performed for every protocol, followed by the steps of the task being annotated. The rules below define a correct annotation. • Indication. Record the disease or condition under study in the protocol’s own wording, keeping disease-defining qualifiers such as stage, severity, or biomarker status and omitting enrolment wording such as “patients with”. Distinct diseases are separate entries, whereas a single disease with several qualifiers is one entry. • Eligibility criteria. Use the detailed eligibility section rather than the synopsis, and include cohort-specific criteria. Each top-level numbered criterion is one item, with its sub-items and any laboratory-threshold table kept inside it. Text is transcribed verbatim, including thresholds, units, and comparison symbols. • Objectives and endpoints. Record every objective with its level, normalized to primary, secondary, or exploratory, and nest under it the endpoints that measure it. An objective without a stated endpoint receives none. • Schedule of Activities. Record a mark for every activity-visit cell, resolving merged cells and multi-level visit headers. Footnote markers are kept as superscripts on the row, cell, or visit they belong to.
blocks.zh: 每项任务都有自己的注释准则。 表7列出了注释员所遵循的步骤:使注释员熟悉研究的一般步骤,为每一项协议进行,然后是附加说明的任务步骤。 以下规则定义了正确的注释. • 指标。 将正在研究的疾病或状况记录在协议本身的措辞中,保留确定疾病的限定词,如阶段、严重程度或生物标记状态,并省略诸如 " 病人 " 的注册措辞。 不同的疾病是单独的条目,而具有若干限定词的单一疾病是一条目。 • 资格标准。 使用详细的资格部分而不是概要,并包括特定组别的标准. 每个顶级编号标准都是一个项目,其子项目和任何实验室阈值表都保留在其中. 文本为逐字转写,包括阈值,单位和比较符号. • 目标和终点。 记录每个目标与水平, 正常化到初级,二级,或探索性, 并巢在其下 测量它的终点。 没有说明终点的目标没有获得任何结果。 • 活动时间表。 记录每个活动访问单元格的标记,解决合并单元格和多级别访问信头。 脚注标记作为上标保存在行上,单元格上,或属于访问.

blocks.en: Coding agents outperform specialist OCR and document-understanding models on SoA table extraction. On page-level SoA extraction (Figure 5 a), the six strongest agents reach 84.3-90.0% Activity-Visit F1, exceeding the best specialist baseline, Mistral OCR, at 71.7%. blocks.en: Coding agents substantially outperform a RAG pipeline on the protocol digitization tasks in TrialPD - Bench . Coding agents outperform RAG with the same model on disease indication (Figure 6 a), eligibility criteria (Figure 6 b), objectives and endpoints (Figure 6 c), and SoA table extraction (Table 18 ). For nine of the ten models, agents improve eligibility criteria F1 by 14.3-55.9% and endpoint F1 by 4.7-28.9%; among these nine, indication F1 also improves for all but Opus 4.6, which ties. The gap is largest for SoA table extraction, where the six strongest agents (GPT-5.6-Sol, GPT-6-Astra, Opus 4.8, Opus 5, Sonnet 5, and Kimi-K3) reach 74.7-86.8% Activity-Visit F1, whereas RAG with the same models reaches only 19.8-51.5%. One possible explanation is that a predefined pipeline determines in advance how documents are parsed and presented to the model, which may limit its generalization and flexibility across protocols and tasks, whereas coding agents can choose and adjust their document-processing strategy for each protocol and task.

blocks.en: We divide the PDFs of each task into these two groups by whether the content needed for that task can be read from the PDF’s native text layer. Only the pages that hold this content are examined, such as the eligibility section for criteria extraction or the SoA page for table extraction. If native text extraction with Poppler and PyMuPDF recovers the content, the PDF is text-sufficient. If the content is scanned, garbled by encoding errors, or otherwise missing from the text layer, so that it can be read only from rendered pages or by OCR, the PDF is vision-required. Scans, encoding failures, mixed documents, and redactions were reviewed manually. Blank pages, scanned signatures, and other pages outside the task content do not affect the division, and model outputs and scores are not used. As a result, the same protocol can be text-sufficient for one task and vision-required for another. Vision-required describes the PDF, not the model: an agent can still read such content with OCR tools even if its language model does not accept images.
blocks.zh: 我们把每个任务的PDF分成这两组, 仅检查持有此内容的页面,例如标准提取的资格部分或表格提取的SoA页面. 如果 Poppler 和 PyMuPDF 的本地文本提取可以恢复内容,则PDF 是文本充足. 如果内容被扫描,被编码错误所粘合,或者从文本层中缺失,从而只能从被渲染的页面或OCR读取,那么PDF是需要视觉的. 对扫描、编码失败、混合文件和编辑进行了人工审查。 空白页面,扫描签名,以及任务内容外的其他页面不影响分区,也不使用模型输出和分数. 因此,同一协议可以满足一项任务所需的文本,而愿景则需要满足另一项任务。 Vision-required 描述PDF而非模型:即使其语言模型不接受图像,代理仍然可以使用OCR工具来读取此类内容.

blocks.en: G.1 Failure Taxonomy
blocks.zh: G.1 失败分类

blocks.en: We define a failing run as a coding-agent run with at least one detected defect, regardless of its score. Defects are detected automatically by comparing each prediction with the reference annotations using Opus-5. The five main types of failure are: • Transcription fidelity : a matching item exists in the prediction, but its text differs from the reference, for example through paraphrase, truncation, or changed operators and numbers. • Long-document localization and coverage : no similar item exists anywhere in the prediction, indicating that the relevant content was not found. • Relational structure reconstruction : the content is present but placed incorrectly, such as SoA marks in the wrong cells, endpoints under the wrong objective, or incorrect epoch order. • Domain concept grounding : the prediction selects a different entity, category, or level than the one requested, such as an incorrect encounter attribute. • Execution reliability : the run produces no usable output, such as a missing, empty, or unparseable file. Figure 4 shows the profile pooled over the nine main-text agents.

blocks.en: H.2.1 Indication Extraction

blocks.en: The indication skill (Table 21 ) targets the disease being treated or prevented rather than the enrolled population. It covers four points. • Source selection. The agent collects candidate wording from three locations, the full title, an explicit indication field in the synopsis, and the primary objective, and decides among them by what each states. A dedicated indication field is preferred when it agrees with the trial purpose, and a shorter title may not remove a disease-defining qualifier. Substudy cohorts, amendment history, and background examples are excluded, and for prevention trials the prevented disease is taken. • Span normalization. The output is the disease noun phrase: enrolment boilerplate such as “treatment of” or “patients with” and age wording are removed, while disease-defining stage, severity, histology, resistance, and biomarkers are kept. Eligibility restrictions that follow the disease in a title are not appended. • Verbatim copying and entry count. The phrase is copied with its original spelling, case, and abbreviations, without expansion. A combined phrase that names one diagnostic population stays one entry; it is split only when the protocol states separate indications, and alternatives are never listed to hedge.

blocks.en: The criteria skill (Table 22 ) aims at a complete, verbatim list. It covers five points. • Locating the section. The agent finds the detailed eligibility section rather than the synopsis or table of contents, identifies where the inclusion and exclusion lists start and end, and follows continuation pages and cohort-specific sections, checking the page after each apparent end of a list. • Source inventory. Before extraction, the agent records the section pages and the printed numbering and counts per category and cohort, so that the output can later be checked against counts taken from the source. • Granularity. Each top-level numbered criterion becomes one item. Sub-items, qualifications, and tables stay inside their parent criterion, and separately numbered criteria are not merged. • Verbatim text and encoding. Criterion text is built from exact source spans in code rather than retyped, with running headers, footers, and top-level numbers removed but units, inequalities, exceptions, and printed dashes preserved. Paragraphs, sub-lists, and tables are encoded in HTML. Pages whose text layer loses characters or symbols are checked visually, and an empty text layer is not taken as evidence that no criteria exist.

blocks.en: The objectives skill (Table 23 ) centers on attaching each endpoint to the right objective. It covers five points. • Two inventories. Objectives and endpoints are often defined in different sections, so the agent builds an inventory of each, compares the synopsis with the detailed definitions, and records each endpoint with its proposed parent objective and the evidence for that link. • List boundaries. A page break does not end a list. For each endpoint subsection, the agent reads until the next heading of the same or a higher level and records the first and last items and the heading that closes the list. • Field conventions. Objective and endpoint texts are copied as complete sentences, levels are normalized to primary, secondary, or exploratory, and each endpoint’s level is read from its own heading rather than inherited from its objective. • Attachment. Endpoints are linked through explicit table rows or cross-references when available, and otherwise by matching the measurement, clinical domain, population, comparison, and time frame to each objective, never by list position. An endpoint may appear under several objectives when the protocol says so, and an objective may have none.

blocks.en: H.2.4 SoA Table Extraction

blocks.en: For SoA table extraction, a skill file (Tables 24 and 25 ) defines the workflow, and a PDF-processing skill supplies extraction patterns. The file covers three points. • Triage. A triage script first measures the page and selects one of three routes: a usable text layer, a text layer that exists but is unusable, or no text layer. • Reading routes. With a usable text layer, the table is parsed with pdfplumber following the PDF skill. With an unusable text layer, the grid may be taken from the text layer, but every character is read from the rendered page. Without a text layer, the table is built from the rendered page alone. • Fix loop. The agent runs a structural checker on its HTML until it reports no problems, such as rows that do not fill the grid, and then reads each visit column header back against the rendered page to confirm the number, order, and levels of the visit columns. Header cells that already match the page are not rewritten, because a single dropped footnote marker changes the identity of every column beneath it.

blocks.en: For structured timeline extraction, an integrated timeline skill (Table 26 ) is supported by a reference note on USDM v4.0. The timeline skill covers four points. • Source inventory. The agent first inventories stages, contacts and activity rows with their pages and quotations in a sidecar source map, and treats missing evidence as null rather than a guessed default. • Epochs. Stages are recorded in study order with a source-supported classification. A visit, an arm or a residence setting is not a stage, and distinct stages are not merged because their types coincide. • Encounters. An encounter is a planned participant contact. Daily contacts in an inpatient period are expanded into day-specific records, and telephone components tied to a numbered visit keep both contact modes. • Activities and timing. Activity definitions are reused across visits and source groupings are preserved. Timing keeps its direction, start/end relationship and window, and refers to existing encounter names.

blocks.en: H.3 Verification Loop
blocks.zh: H.3 核查循环

blocks.en: The harness runs the verification loop after every draft. Each phase runs in a new agent session: the draft phase writes the candidate output, and the audit phase receives the protocol and the candidate with read-only access and follows the audit checklist in the task skill. The auditor writes a structured report containing a pass or fail verdict, concrete content issues with the affected output field, the problem, a source-supported correction, and the relevant pages, the source sections it checked, short quotes from the source as evidence, and any unresolved uncertainties.
blocks.zh: 每份草稿之后 都由绳子负责核查 每个阶段在一个新的代理会话中运行:阶段草案写出候选产出,审计阶段接收协议和只读访问的候选者,并遵循任务技能的审计清单. 审计员撰写了一份结构化的报告,其中载有通过或失败的裁决、受影响产出领域的具体内容问题、问题、来源支持的更正、相关网页、它检查的源部分、来源的简短引证作为证据以及任何未解决的不确定性。

blocks.en: A gold-free gate then checks the report for schema validity and internal consistency: the report must be well formed, a failing verdict must list concrete issues, a passing verdict must list none, the checked pages must exist in the document, and the report must refer to the candidate. The gate also checks that the candidate follows the task schema. Evidence quotes that cannot be found in the PDF text layer raise a warning without blocking the output. If errors remain, the agent applies minimal source-supported fixes in a new session: it reads the audit feedback, rechecks the source pages, corrects only the reported content or schema errors, and leaves supported text unchanged. The revised output is then audited again, for at most two rounds. An incomplete report triggers one repeated audit. For SoA table extraction, verification instead runs within the agent’s current session: the agent repeatedly checks its HTML table against the rendered page and revises it until the checks pass (Figure 10 ).
blocks.zh: 一个无金之门然后检查报告是否具有计划有效性和内部一致性:报告必须形成良好,失败的裁决必须列出具体问题,通过的裁决必须列出任何问题,文件中必须有检查的页,报告必须提到候选人。 大门还检查候选人是否遵循任务计划。 PDF 文本层中无法找到的证据引出在不屏蔽输出的情况下发出警告. 如果错误依然存在,代理在新会话中应用了源支持的最小修正:它读取审计反馈,重新检查源页面,只更正所报告内容或计划错误,并保留所支持文本不变. 然后再次审计订正产出,最多两轮。 一份不完整的报告引发一次重复审计。 对于 SoA 表格提取, 验证会运行在代理当前会话内: 代理根据已提供的页面反复检查其 HTML 表格并修改, 直至检查通过( 图10 ) 。

blocks.zh: H.4 技能和核查的差别

blocks.en: We ablate the two components of TrialScribe , the task skills and the verification loop, on 40 eligibility-criteria protocols randomly sampled from the test split, with Qwen3.8-27B. We compare four configurations: the base coding agent, skills only, verification only, and the full TrialScribe . As Table 27 shows, each component improves criterion F1 on its own, by 2.6 points for skills and 7.7 points for verification, and combining them gives the largest gain, 14.5 points over the base agent. Verification adds more when the skills are present (11.9 vs. 7.7 points).

blocks.en: The protocol documents in TrialPD - Bench are publicly posted on ClinicalTrials.gov ( U.S. National Library of Medicine, ) , the trial registry of the U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM), where sponsors upload protocols as part of results reporting. We do not redistribute the protocol PDFs. Instead, we release the NCT identifier and the ClinicalTrials.gov URL of each document, so that users obtain the documents directly from the registry. The structured timeline references are taken from the USDM example studies published by CDISC ( CDISC, ) , which we use as released and credit to CDISC. Our reference annotations and code are released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0) license.
